data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2024 were GBP 60.337m. During 2024 there was a net favourable prior year reserve movement of GBP 5.786m (release), primarily attributed to good experience on longer-tail business and Specialty classes relating to the 2021 and 2022 underwriting years. The Syndicate writes reinsurance acceptances (quota share of host Syndicate 1910) and the reserves are held on a funds-withheld basis; post-balance sheet wildfires in Los Angeles (Jan 2025) are expected to give rise to material losses but are not included in the 2024 technical provisions.
raw_causal_phrases: The Syndicate has also seen improvement in its prior year reserves for 2021 & 2022, due to good experience on its longer tail and Specialty classes.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year movement taken from Technical Provisions reconciliation 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' (gross = (5,786) GBP 000 => release of 5.786m). Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' prior year column (60,337 GBP 000). Gross premium mix only lists 'Reinsurance acceptances' in the segmental/analysis tables; no further statutory class breakdown provided for total premium. Post-balance sheet LA wildfires (7 Jan 2025) noted and may affect future reserves. Claims development triangle exists but is limited to UW years 2022-2024; RITC and funds-withheld structure may distort certain comparisons.
